questions.question: What is the role of soil minerals in soil composition? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• What is the Role of soil minerals in soil composition
  • Soil minerals are essential components that determine the physical and chemical
  • properties of soil. They provide essential nutrients like potassium, calcium,
  • magnesium, and iron required for plant growth. Minerals also influence soil texture,
  • structure, water retention capacity, and fertility. Additionally, they play a key role in
  • maintaining soil pH and supporting microbial activity in the soil.

questions.question: Discuss how hand care products help maintain skin health. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss how hand care products help maintain skin health.
  • Hand care products such as soaps, hand washes, sanitizers, and moisturizers play an
  • important role in protecting and nourishing the skin.
  • • Cleansing action: Soaps and hand washes remove dirt, oils, and harmful
  • microorganisms, helping to maintain hygiene and prevent infections.
  • • Moisturization: Creams and lotions contain emollients and humectants that keep
  • the skin hydrated and prevent dryness and cracking.
  • • Protection: Some products form a protective barrier on the skin, shielding it from
  • environmental damage such as pollution and chemicals.
  • • Antimicrobial effect: Hand sanitizers and medicated hand washes reduce or kill
  • germs, lowering the risk of disease transmission.
  • • Skin nourishment: Many hand care products include vitamins and natural
  • extracts that improve skin texture and promote healing. (Each point have one
  • mark )
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the basic steps involved in making a hand wash. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the basic steps involved in making a hand wash
  • Selection of ingredients:
  • Choose suitable surfactants (cleansing agents), water, thickening agents,
  • preservatives, fragrance, and color.
  • Preparation of base solution:
  • Take distilled water and slowly add the primary surfactant (e.g., SLES) with gentle
  • stirring to avoid foam formation.
  • Addition of secondary ingredients:
  • Add co-surfactants, humectants (like glycerin), and thickening agents to improve
  • texture and moisturizing property.
  • Incorporation of additives:
  • Add preservatives to prevent microbial growth, followed by fragrance and color as
  • required.
  • pH adjustment:
  • Adjust the pH to a skin-friendly range (around 5.5–7) using suitable agents like citric
  • acid.
  • Mixing and homogenization:
  • Stir the mixture thoroughly to obtain a uniform and stable formulation.
  • • Filling and packaging:
  • Transfer the prepared hand wash into clean containers and seal properly.
  • (Each point have one mark )
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define nail polish. Describe the meanings and significance of the terms nail lacquer and nail enamel. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the meanings and significance of the terms nail acquer and nail enamel.
  • Nail Polish:
  • Nail polish is a cosmetic preparation applied to fingernails or toenails to decorate,
  • protect, and enhance their appearance. It typically consists of film-forming agents
  • (like nitrocellulose), solvents, plasticizers, resins, and color pigments.
  • Nail Lacquer:
  • • Meaning: Nail lacquer refers to a type of nail polish with a high-gloss, smooth,
  • and durable finish.
  • • Significance: It forms a thin, hard film on the nail surface that dries quickly and
  • provides a shiny, long-lasting coating. It is commonly used for its aesthetic appeal
  • and quick-drying property.
  • Nail Enamel:
  • • Meaning: Nail enamel is a thicker and more opaque form of nail polish.
  • • Significance: It provides better coverage, stronger adhesion, and enhanced
  • protection to the nail. It often gives a richer color and smoother finish, helping to
  • prevent chipping and damage. (Each point have 1.5 marks)
